reason: Separate CUDA training cohort. CPU long continuations are excluded; host memory stability is a launch constraint.
initialization: Same init_seed=data_seed and same CPU-created initial state before .to(cuda); pair input/init hashes to the CPU reference, but GPU trajectory is fresh and separate.
input_policy: Copy the exact same 20 NPZ and metadata bytes; their original generation protocol/hash remains authoritative.
checkpoint_policy: No CPU optimizer/model/curve checkpoint is imported. Start every declared GPU task from scratch and retain its own 150/500/1500 states. Resume only CUDA checkpoints from this new source/config/device identity.
comparison_policy: CPU epoch-150 OAT and GPU budget trajectories remain separate cohorts; never splice CPU150 with GPU500/1500. Cross-device optimization values need not be bitwise identical.
non_evidence_pilots: Sequential three-step CUDA state/RNG/noninterference tests followed by four-worker 150-step runtime/memory pilot in separate output subroots; never formal evidence.
resource_policy: Recorded launch limits: MemoryMax6G/MemoryHigh5G/MemorySwapMax0/CPUQuota400%/Nice5/OOMPolicystop/Restartno; require host MemAvailable>=12GiB and target>=8GiB margin; workers<=4 selected after measured pilot host RAM (<4GiB for four workers).
